description: List Ply registry components filtered by tier, category, or a case-insensitive substring, sorted by name. Not a fuzzy match: search_components ranks uncertain names, and get_component reads one known name. Does not install. To copy a component into a project, tell the user to run npx ply-ui-cli add <name>.
